QuestInfo.name: Ghosts of the Past
QuestInfo.parent: The Secret of the Ghost Ship
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9270030##k in Boat Quay Town looks like he could use some help. He's spooked out!
QuestInfo.1:
#p9270030# told you a crazy story about a ghost ship on the coastline. He sounds a little crazy, but he really seemed to believe it was true. See if you can find any of the #b#o9420509##k and #b#o9420510##k ghosts around Boat Quay Town!

#o9420509#  #r#a45101##k
#o9420510#  #r#a45102##k
QuestInfo.2: What a surprise! #p9270030# was telling you the truth!  Go see him again right away.

0.0: Hey, man... it's not every day people ignore the threads to talk to this old bum. You wanna know how I ended up here? I used to be a captain, real top-of-the-line seafarin' type. But then I ran into a ship full of ghosts right off the coast, and my life took a turn for the worse...
0.1: My crew was gone before I knew it, swimmin' back to land, screamin' the whole way. I wish I could say I wasn't in the water right behind 'em... The worst part was, we got to shore, and nobody believed us. I was stuck here, not a penny to my name...
0.2: I sure miss the good old days... Wish I could get over being scared of the sea. You know what I mean?

yes.0: You believe me? I swear, I'm not tellin' any lies. Just go out to the Ghost Ship on the coast, and you'll see! Take down #b100 #o9420509# and #o9420510#sk ghosts, and you'll see!

1.0: Did you see it? The Ghost Ship? I told you, man, I told you! Look, I don't got much, but I got this...

mob.0: I think you've got a few more #b#o9420509##k and #b#o9420510##k ghosts to deal with.
